summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report management's unaudited estimate of net asset value (NAV) per share at $13.39 as of July 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure required for business development companies, providing the estimated NAV per share for investors. The filing contains no transaction, corporate action event, or special-situation development — it is a standard mark-to-market NAV update, not an acquisition, tender, spin-off, or other categorized special situation. The BDC provides the estimate for the month-end to inform shareholders of portfolio valuation. What to watch: No special-situation angle; routine BDC operational disclosure.
